results.source_or_method: Fetch canonical public URL and record status/final URL.
results.limitation: Reachability does not prove indexation or search demand.

results.source_or_method: Fetch robots.txt and sitemap locations when public.
results.limitation: Presence does not prove complete crawl coverage or indexation.

results.source_or_method: Inspect index directives, canonical tags and redirect behavior on sampled templates.
results.limitation: Sampled directives do not prove full-domain index state.

results.source_or_method: Run dated brand query and record visible result/snippet evidence.
results.limitation: One query snapshot does not prove stable visibility share.

results.source_or_method: Run at least three dated non-brand intent queries relevant to visible offer/market.
results.limitation: Sampled queries do not prove complete keyword coverage or business performance.

results.source_or_method: Inspect sampled titles, descriptions, H1/H2 structure and intent alignment.
results.limitation: Sample quality does not prove rankings.

results.source_or_method: Inspect public structured data for syntax, entity fit and visible-content consistency.
results.limitation: Markup presence does not guarantee rich results.

results.source_or_method: Inspect navigation depth, contextual links, descriptive anchors, breadcrumbs and orphan-risk patterns in bounded sample.
results.limitation: Bounded crawl does not prove complete link graph.

results.source_or_method: Inspect sampled image alt text, context, filenames and responsive image delivery.
results.limitation: Sample does not prove image-search performance.

results.source_or_method: Inspect applicable local entity and language-alternate signals.
results.limitation: Signals do not prove local rankings or international targeting success.

results.source_or_method: Use current public/user-authorized real-user field metrics for URL/origin when available.
results.limitation: Field sample does not prove every visit or business outcome.

results.source_or_method: Run controlled mobile lab measurement and retain tool/date/config.
results.limitation: Lab result is not real-user field performance.

results.source_or_method: Run controlled desktop lab measurement and retain tool/date/config.
results.limitation: Lab result is not real-user field performance.

results.source_or_method: Measure sampled transfer/resource weight and identify dominant resource classes.
results.limitation: Asset weight alone does not prove user-perceived speed.

results.source_or_method: Inspect formats, responsive images, lazy loading and media delivery on sampled templates.
results.limitation: Observed media pipeline does not prove field performance.

results.source_or_method: Inspect public caching/compression headers or reproducible response behavior.
results.limitation: Headers alone do not prove end-to-end caching effectiveness.

results.source_or_method: Inspect sampled blocking CSS/JS/resource dependencies with available lab or page tooling.
results.limitation: Static inspection does not prove exact blocking time.

results.source_or_method: Inspect responsive rendering and delivery on representative mobile/desktop viewports.
results.limitation: Viewport sample does not cover every device.

results.source_or_method: Record observable delivery/CMS/framework hints without asserting private architecture.
results.limitation: Public hints do not prove repository, backend or deployment quality.

results.source_or_method: Inspect whether first screen states entity/offer/audience/value clearly.
results.limitation: Heuristic clarity does not measure conversion.

results.source_or_method: Inspect prominence and clarity of the primary next action.
results.limitation: CTA clarity does not measure conversion uplift.

results.source_or_method: Inspect labels, navigation paths, orientation and information scent.
results.limitation: Sampled navigation does not prove task success for all users.

results.source_or_method: Inspect mobile text hierarchy, spacing, tap targets and content order in sample viewport.
results.limitation: Viewport review is not full device testing.

results.source_or_method: Inspect public contact/form path for field burden, clarity and visible friction without submitting.
results.limitation: Form-surface review does not measure completion rate.

results.source_or_method: Inspect trust cues located near decision/contact moments.
results.limitation: Visible proof cues do not establish claim truth.

results.source_or_method: Inspect visual/content hierarchy and scanability on representative templates.
results.limitation: Heuristic hierarchy does not replace user testing.

results.source_or_method: Inspect visible validation/error/feedback states only when safely observable without submission.
results.limitation: Untriggered states may remain not assessed.

results.source_or_method: Keyboard-sample navigation and visible focus on representative interactive elements.
results.limitation: Sample does not establish WCAG conformance.

results.source_or_method: Inspect landmarks, headings, labels and semantic structure in sampled HTML.
results.limitation: Sample does not establish WCAG conformance.

results.source_or_method: Inspect representative informative/decorative image alternatives.
results.limitation: Sample does not establish complete alternative-text quality.

results.source_or_method: Measure or inspect representative text/background contrast with a reproducible method.
results.limitation: Sample does not establish full WCAG conformance.

results.source_or_method: Inspect public form labels/names/instructions without submission.
results.limitation: Sample does not establish complete accessible form behavior.

results.source_or_method: Run automated accessibility snapshot and retain tool/version/page scope.
results.limitation: Automation alone does not establish WCAG conformance.

results.source_or_method: Check visible imprint/legal surface presence and accessibility.
results.limitation: Presence does not establish legal compliance.

results.source_or_method: Inspect visible privacy/consent surface and consistency with observed public behavior where possible.
results.limitation: Surface review is not legal advice or compliance proof.

results.source_or_method: Check HTTPS and selected public security headers without active exploitation.
results.limitation: Header presence/absence does not prove security posture.

results.source_or_method: Compare entity, contact, service and location facts across sampled public surfaces.
results.limitation: Consistency does not prove factual accuracy beyond public evidence.

results.source_or_method: Inspect visible dates, team/service/project recency and stale references.
results.limitation: Visible freshness does not prove operational freshness.

results.source_or_method: Inspect references, testimonials, credentials, cases and proof-to-claim proximity.
results.limitation: Presence of proof points does not independently verify every claim.

results.source_or_method: Inspect public contact identity, channels and location transparency.
results.limitation: Transparency does not prove responsiveness or service quality.

results.source_or_method: Inspect user-authorized analytics/search measurement readiness or public tag evidence only within permission.
results.limitation: Tag presence does not prove data quality or business attribution.

results.source_or_method: Check whether the entity can be explicitly identified from visible content and structured data.
results.limitation: Extractability does not prove AI citation.

results.source_or_method: Check explicit service, audience, location and applicability statements.
results.limitation: Clarity does not prove AI visibility.

results.source_or_method: Check direct answer sections, FAQs and question-to-answer structure.
results.limitation: Answerability does not prove chatbot inclusion.

results.source_or_method: Inspect summaries, schema and machine-readable organization of key facts.
results.limitation: Structure does not guarantee AI or search presentation.

results.source_or_method: Inspect whether material claims are near attributable proof/cases/references.
results.limitation: Visible evidence mapping does not certify claim truth.

results.source_or_method: Compare key entity/service/location facts across sampled pages and structured surfaces.
results.limitation: Sampled consistency does not prove whole-site consistency.

results.source_or_method: Inspect topical depth and coverage of likely user questions across sampled content.
results.limitation: Depth does not prove topical authority or AI visibility.
